extras.notes: bow faces -Y, stands on its keel at z = 0 (waterline at about 1 m: cream boot stripe above the red bottom); dark clinker planked hull with a teal sheer stripe, light planked deck with bulwark, gaff mainsail with boom and gaff, jib on a long bowsprit, shrouds with deadeyes and stays, four small deck guns on red carriages, grated hatch, barrels, stern lantern (emissive flame), rudder with tiller; no flags, no moving parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
